name: Eastwall Tower
summary: Eastwall Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the Eastern Plaguelands near the eastern road. Sacked during the Third War when the Scourge swept across the kingdom, its remains overlook the Scourge-infested wilderness.

sections.title: A Ruined Watch on the Border
sections.body: Built as a border sentinel for the kingdom of Lordaeron, Eastwall Tower once watched over travelers heading toward the far reaches of the realm. When the Scourge invaded during the Third War, the outpost was crushed along with the surrounding settlements, leaving shattered stone arches and burnt timber behind. Now, with the Lich King's armies still infesting the region, the tower's elevated position makes it an indispensable forward post. Its ruined ramparts overlook roads through the Scourge-infested countryside.

faq.q: What was Eastwall Tower before it fell?
faq.answer: Eastwall Tower was originally a defensive scout tower constructed by the Kingdom of Lordaeron. It formed part of the regional border watch network, safeguarding trade routes and outlying farms before the Third War brought about Lordaeron's fall.

The tower was destroyed by the Scourge during Prince Arthas Menethil's conquest and the subsequent undead ravaging of Lordaeron. Undead monstrosities smashed its defenses, leaving the defenders dead and the structure in ruins.

faq.q: Why is the tower strategically important?
faq.answer: Even in ruins, the tower commands high ground along the eastern roadways of the Plaguelands, overlooking the Scourge-infested countryside.

faq.q: Is the tower safe to rest at?
faq.answer: The ruined tower stands in Scourge-infested countryside and offers no secure refuge.

angles.text: For the Alliance, retaking Eastwall Tower honors the fallen soldiers of Lordaeron and secures the approach to Light's Hope Chapel against Scourge incursions.
The ruined scout tower overlooks roads through the hostile northern lands.
